♡Family Today♡

The storm cleared out overnight and took the humidity with it. Today starts the good stretch: three days of sun, none of it hot, and 53° tonight with the windows open.
  • Sep 13Bills at Houston, Jets at Tennessee — both at 1:00
  • Sep 26Harvest Moon, full at 12:48 p.m.
  • Nov 3Election Day
Had a migraine? Say so in the group chat — the day and roughly when — and the paper will mark it on the Barograph. Enough entries and we will know what the glass does before one hits.

☾The Almanac Sky☾

New moon tonight, 11:26 p.m. — no moon in the sky at all, and the darkest night of the month. The next crescent shows up low in the west on Saturday evening.
Sun 6:49a – 7:34p · 12h 45m · 2h 38m shorter than June 21
New moon Tonight, 11:26 · Harvest Moon Sat, Sep 26
Tonight Venus low in the west after sunset, gone by 8:42. Saturn rises in the east at 8:34 and is up the rest of the night. Jupiter comes up at 3:59 a.m. Clear sky, no moon, dry air: if there is one night this month to walk outside and look up, it is this one. Away from the streetlights the Milky Way should be plain.

↓ bottoming out
The bottom of the dip The barometer is at 29.92, down another twelve hundredths, but the storm has gone by and this is the low point rather than a fall in progress. It should start climbing back this afternoon and keep climbing through the weekend. Slow rises are the easy kind. Yesterday was the day to be careful; today is not.

✶The Ledger✶

Days until the Canada import ban
19
On September 29 a list of Canadian goods stops crossing the border entirely. Thirty minutes from the house, that is not an abstraction — it is the shelf at the duty-free and a fair number of jobs on both sides of the river.

✶The National Wire✶

1

Trump Bans a List of Canadian Goods, Widens the Tariffs

Some alcohol, dairy and motorcycles are barred from entering the U.S. starting September 29, and 50 percent tariffs now cover golf carts, mattresses and more cheese. Road salt came off the list.

2

Republicans Hold Their First Midterm Convention

In Dallas, Trump promised a $5,000 “dividend” if the party keeps Congress and said the Iran war would end right after the election. Several prominent Republicans stayed home.

3

Iran Referred to the U.N. Security Council

The IAEA reported Tehran for failing to cooperate with an investigation into uranium traces at undeclared sites. Iran called the resolution a fabrication.

4

Twenty-Five Years, Tomorrow

The September 11 anniversary falls on Friday. A steel beam from the South Tower goes back through the Brooklyn-Battery Tunnel, the same route Stephen Siller ran on foot that morning.

☑ The Ballot · 54 days to Election Day · early voting Oct 24–Nov 1 · register by Oct 24

🏈The Gridiron🏈

Season Opens, Patriots Fall 13–10
The league started Wednesday night in Seattle, and New England let one get away. Drake Maye threw three interceptions, the Patriots led 10–0 into the fourth, and then Sam Darnold's replacement — Drew Lock — hit Jaxon Smith-Njigba for 45 yards and a touchdown, and Jason Myers kicked a 26-yarder with 5:53 left. New England held the ball for 34 minutes and lost anyway. That is one down in the AFC East. Rams and 49ers play tonight.
Three Days to Kickoff
Bills · at Houston, Sunday 1:00 on FOX. Khalil Shakir still has not practiced; Friday's final report settles whether he plays, and the team keeps saying it expects him to. Terrel Bernard is the other name to watch. Houston is thinner: receiver Jayden Higgins is out for the season, and Tank Dell and right tackle Braden Smith miss at least four games.
Jets · at Tennessee, Sunday 1:00 on CBS. Breece Hall practiced and is on track to start, which matters more than anything else on the offense. Joseph Ossai is still week-to-week. On the other side, Robert Saleh gets his first game against the team that fired him, likely without Cedric Gray, his leading tackler, who is in concussion protocol.

⚑The Chase⚑

Three Days to Gateway
Practice and qualifying Saturday, the Enjoy Illinois 300 Sunday at 3 on USA. Hamlin carries a twelve-point lead over Bell into a track where tire management decides everything and track position is hard to buy back. Nine races left after this one, no eliminations, and the whole thing settles at Homestead on November 8.

★The Marquee★

1

The Palace Letter

Harry and Meghan were reportedly surprised by King Charles's letter setting out their standing in the family. Neither side has said much publicly, which in that family counts as loud.

2

Country Music Reads Its Nominations

The 60th CMA Awards list came out this morning, part of it on Good Morning America. The show is November 18 at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville.

3

The Craft Emmys Air Saturday

Two nights of Creative Arts awards, taped last weekend, are edited into one broadcast Saturday on FXX. The main ceremony follows Monday on NBC.

☾On This Day☾

September 10, 1846 — Elias Howe patented the lockstitch sewing machine. He spent the next decade suing everyone who copied it, won, and collected a royalty on nearly every machine sold in America until 1867.

I have a head and a foot but no body, and I am never used until you stop moving. What am I? Answer below the fold.
